items.title: APEC SUMMIT PUTS THREE POWERS IN FOCUS
items.summary: Donald Trump held separate talks with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen, with Ukraine and wider security issues on the agenda ahead of planned trilateral discussions.

items.title: CRIMEAN BRIDGE HIT AGAIN
items.summary: Ukraine struck the bridge for a third time in a week, Russian authorities said. Rail services were suspended; officials reported no injuries and were assessing the damage.

items.title: WORLD COURT DELIVERS ROHINGYA JUDGMENT
items.summary: The International Court of Justice delivered its judgment in the Gambia v. Myanmar case concerning allegations of genocide against the Rohingya.
